description: Build the m2m-split transaction for a quote: the payer's transfer to the payee and the USDC fee transfer to the treasury, in one atomic transaction where the payer pays its own gas. Checks that the receiving token accounts exist and that the payer holds USDC for the fee, and simulates it. Unsigned. Sign it locally with your own Solana key; m2m.monster never sees or uses agents' private keys.

max_compute_unit_price.description: Lower priority fee cap in micro-lamports per compute unit

payer.description: The payer wallet; it signs and pays the network fee

quote.description: The signed quote exactly as returned by quote_payment

name: build_payment
